_about: A300F4-600 (the A300-600 freighter: FedEx's and UPS's), from Airbus, A300F4-600 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (Dec 01/09; the copy on aircraft.airbus.com's Aircraft Characteristics page), 2.2 Airplane Dimensions, Model A300F4-600 (Jan 30/94): page 2 (page index 17), a scan of about 33 px a meter with its side and front views, no grid. The side view evened out (layers.py --scale 4.677 --xscale 1.069: drawn 6.9% taller than long), the front view rendered to its scale (4.89: drawn 2.3% larger, by its printed 44.84 m span; its nacelles drawn 16.5 m apart are placed at the printed 15.88 m). The plan is the A300B4's with the -600's 0.47 m (plan.py: page 1's plan isn't to one scale). Scaled by the printed 54.08 m from the nose to the tail cone. No cabin windows. Doors as drawn: the crew door (left; drawn down to the centerline), the main-deck cargo door (left), the lower-deck forward and aft cargo doors and the bulk door (right, drawn dashed). The nacelle is the CF6-80C2's the sheet draws. The cockpit panes are the A30B's (the same nose), moved as its points are. The tailplane is drawn as the B4's 16.9 m and narrowed to the printed 16.26 m. No wingtip fence: the sheet doesn't draw one.

windows.note: The A300-600F has no cabin windows.

sources.title: Airbus, A300F4-600 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (Dec 01/09), 2.2 General Airplane Dimensions and Airplane Dimensions, Model A300F4-600 (Jan 30/94)
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off 2.2's side and front views (page 2, tools/trace/a306/), a 1994 scan of about 33 px a meter without a grid, starting from the A300B4's points (tools/trace/a30b/) moved onto it and snapped; the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The side view is drawn 6.9% taller than long (the tube 6.03 m against its printed 5.64 m, the fin 8.88 m above the crown against its printed 8.30 m) and is evened out; the front view is drawn 2.3% large against its printed 44.84 m span and is rendered to the side's scale. Page 1's plan is on graph paper and not to one scale (3% wider than long), so the plan is the B4's (the same wing and section) with the -600's 0.47 m longer aft fuselage (a plug at 34.4 m: plan.py), which the side view bears out: its fin is the B4's 0.47 m further aft, within a line's width. The tail cone, the belly's sweep up to it and the CF6-80C2 nacelle are this sheet's. The tailplane is drawn as the B4's 16.9 m and narrowed to the printed 16.26 m. The front view draws the nacelles 16.5 m apart against the printed 15.88 m: placed at the print. The A300-600's wingtip fences aren't drawn on this sheet and aren't in the shape. No cabin windows. Doors as drawn: the crew door (left; drawn down to the centerline), the main-deck cargo door (left, 3.63 by 2.29 m drawn), the lower-deck forward and aft cargo doors and the bulk door (right, drawn dashed).
